out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the at the bar and at the dish washing area were being used for washing of utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. MAMA TIGRE (Inspection Date: 02/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Ground beef, inside the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. ( Food transferred on trays and rapidly cooled to under 39F, inside the walk-in freezer, in less than 1 hour.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: overloading of food containers for cooling.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. You may also place foods on trays and cool to 41F or lower, in the freezer without freezing the food, and transfer to the refrigerator for cold-holding. CORRECTED DURING THE. INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Unmarked squeeze bottles containing liquids and sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the self-closing device on the door of the walk-in cooler is not operating properly, and in need of repair. Employees were observed not closing the door while the cooler was being used.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair or replace the closing device if it can no longer be fixed, to maintain proper ambient temperature in the cooler.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the dueling light fixtures were dusty and in need of cleaning. The ceiling inside the walk-in refrigerator is in needs of cleaning. The floor inside the walk-in freezer is also in need of cleaning.is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Infrared/Heat Lamp Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that a proper protective shields are not provided for the ceiling light bulbs in some areas.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a shield to surround and extend beyond the bulb so that only the face of the bulb is exposed.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: EHS observed no disclosure statement for steak tacos, carne tacos, carne asada and fajitas
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC re- printed disclosure statement for a table top tent.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: EHS observed damp wiping rags being stored on the counter and cutting boards in the kitchen area near the cookline and the food prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC moved rags to being stored in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: EHS observed manufacturer containers for granulated garlic being re-used to store black pepper, bay leaves, salt and sugar.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to stop re-using. Containers

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: EHS observed ice machine in the back kitchen not clean to sight and touch.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC agreed to clean the ice machine by next inspection MAMA TIGRE (Inspection Date: 01/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: EHS observed the ceilings and walls of the kitchen area in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to clean the ceiling by next inspection
